important_instructions: Report to the exam centre at least 2 hours before the exam for verification and frisking. The main gate closes 30 minutes before the exam starts (9:30 AM, as the exam begins at 10:00 AM); no entry is allowed after this. Carry the admit card, a black or blue ballpoint pen, and an original photo ID (Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN Card, or Aadhaar Card). Wear light-coloured, half-sleeve clothing; black, dark blue, dark green, purple, maroon, and dark chocolate-coloured clothing is not permitted. Wear slippers/sandals as footwear; ear ornaments of any kind are not allowed. Communication devices, electronic devices, electronic watches, purses, pouches, scarves, belts, and caps are strictly prohibited inside the exam hall. Candidates in religious or cultural attire must report early and undergo additional security checks. Leaving the exam room during the first and last 30 minutes of the exam is not permitted. Objections to the provisional answer key can be raised online only, with a fee of ₹50 per question and supporting evidence; objections by post, email, or in person are not accepted. Re-checking or re-evaluation of OMR answer sheets is not permitted, as evaluation is done by machine.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should note the following dates related to CG Teacher Recruitment 2026 (LST26) carefully, as no offline extensions are provided.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Vacancy 2026 - Subject-Wise Details
content_sections.text: Note: Selection against these posts is subject to the final order to be passed by the Supreme Court of India, New Delhi, in SLP(C) No. 019668/2022.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet any one of the following qualifications: Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) Graduation with minimum 50% marks + B.Ed. Graduation with minimum 45% marks + B.Ed. , as per applicable NCTE norms Higher Secondary (12th) with minimum 50% marks + 4-year B.El.Ed./B.A.B.Ed./B.Sc.B.Ed. Graduation with minimum 50% marks + 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education) Must have qualified Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) as prescribed by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE). Subject-wise graduation requirements also apply for Hindi, Sanskrit, English, Mathematics, Social Science and Agriculture posts

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 01 January 2026 : Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 35 years Chhattisgarh SC/ST/OBC candidates: Upper-age relaxation of 5 years Persons with Disabilities: Additional relaxation as per government rules Other specified categories, including certain Chhattisgarh government employees/ex-servicemen/award recipients, have additional age relaxations as mentioned in the notification. Note: After applying all applicable relaxations, the maximum age for entry into government service is stated as 45 years . To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026 is category-based and must be paid online at the time of application submission. Local resident candidates of Chhattisgarh who appear for the exam get their application fee refunded by CGSSB to the same bank account used for payment, as per applicable government orders.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026 is based on a written examination (LST26) conducted by CGSSB. The exam consists of 100 objective-type questions, carrying 1 mark each. Total exam duration is 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:15 PM). Each question has four options; candidates must fully darken one circle using a blue or black ballpoint pen on the OMR sheet. Negative marking applies: 1/4 mark is deducted for a wrong answer or for marking more than one option. Unattempted questions are awarded zero marks. Document verification, final selection, and appointment are handled separately by the recruiting department and are outside CGSSB's scope.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026 through the CGSSB website using the steps below. Visit the official website vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or cgssb.cgstate.gov.in. Complete the new online Profile Registration if not already registered. Upload a recent light-background photograph in JPG/JPEG format (minimum 50 KB, maximum 100 KB). Upload a scanned signature in JPG/JPEG format (minimum 50 KB, maximum 100 KB). Select the LST26 Teacher recruitment exam and fill in the required application details based on your profile registration. Pay the applicable category-wise application fee online. Review all entered details carefully and click "SUBMIT" to complete the application. Download and keep a printout of the submitted online application form for future reference. Caste, date of birth, domicile, educational qualification, disability, and ex-servicemen certificates are not collected at the application stage; these will be verified later by the recruiting authority. CGSSB is not responsible for information furnished by the candidate, so applicants should fill the form carefully.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment Admit Card
content_sections.text: The admit card for LST26 is expected to be released around 19 October 2026 on the official website. Candidates can download it by logging into their profile on the CGSSB portal. The admit card must be printed on one side of each page and retained even after the exam, as it may be required during the selection/joining process.

content_sections.heading: CG Teacher Recruitment Exam Centres
content_sections.text: The LST26 exam will be held at coordination centres in 16 district headquarters across Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q1. What is CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Directorate of Public Instruction, Chhattisgarh, for 1654 Teacher posts in Hindi, Sanskrit, English, Mathematics, Social Science, and Agriculture, with the written exam (LST26) conducted by CGSSB.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1654 vacancies are notified, though the advertisement states this number is subject to change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 2 September 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
Q5. What is the application fee for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹350 for General category, ₹250 for OBC, and ₹200 for SC/ST/PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted online at vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or cgssb.cgstate.gov.in through the new profile registration form.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CG Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written exam of 100 objective questions carrying 1 mark each, with 1/4 negative marking, over a 2-hour duration.

faq.question: Q8. When is the CG Teacher Recruitment 2026 exam date?
faq.answer: The exam is provisionally scheduled for 25 October 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:15 PM.
